Internal: message text shared by more than one function

Source: R/utils.R
dot-jst_shared_text.Rd

Constants holding the fixed text of messages that several functions print, each used where its message is built, so the wording is changed in one place (Session 383, the hygiene slate; the S381 item). Each value is the text its sites printed before the merge, byte for byte.

Details

.jst_txt_jencode_first

the type refusals' remedy for a factor or text variable: jrecode(), jrelabel(), jdeclare_missing(), the registration verbs, a computed formula term.

.jst_txt_modify_unnamed, .jst_txt_name_first

the first two sentences of the stop for modify = TRUE on a data frame given as an expression or a place: jrelabel(), jdeclare_missing(), jconvert().

.jst_txt_pd_instead, .jst_txt_pd_sav

the lead of the preserve.declarations = FALSE route in jsave()'s .dta and .sav refusals.

.jst_txt_plot_nav

the line under a list of plots.

.jst_txt_new_column, .jst_txt_new_column_it

the remedy for a formula term jstats cannot use as written.

.jst_txt_first_arg_frame

the recode family's stop for a first argument that is not a data frame.

.jst_txt_vars_quoted

the stop for vars = that does not hold names in quotes.

.jst_txt_add_overwrite

the way to replace, under the way to keep, in the stop the overwrite question gives when its answer is not y or n – jload(), jsave(), jcopy() – and in jsave()'s stop where the session cannot ask. Since Session 391 (the (S298) E8 item, Jeff's okay of the lean) the stop names both ways out, the way to keep first, where it had offered only the destructive one ("Add overwrite = TRUE to the call, then run it again.").

.jst_txt_keep_file

jsave()'s way to keep the file, in the same two stops (Session 391).

.jst_txt_map_commas, .jst_txt_na_longhand, .jst_txt_na_one_rule, .jst_txt_map_empty

the map parsers' messages, numeric and text.

.jst_txt_frame_each_var

the close of the stops for a variable given with its data frame attached.

.jst_txt_default_route

the lead of the second route when no data frame is named.

.jst_txt_provide_two_vars

jcorr(), jsum() and javg() given fewer than two variables.

.jst_txt_jai_cannot_ask, .jst_txt_jai_set_path

jai()'s writing setups.

.jst_txt_jai_other_folder

jai()'s line naming path =, under a declined write and a folder R cannot write to (Session 391).

.jst_txt_value_id

value.id given to a function that shows no value labels.

.jst_txt_qq_produced

jt() and jaov()'s Q-Q plot line.

.jst_txt_full_distribution

the close of jsum() and javg()'s keep-it note.

.jst_txt_levene_caption

the title of Levene's test in jt() and jaov().

.jst_txt_stata_markers_na

the stata option's line in the convention menus.

.jst_txt_assign_expr

the assign-or-lose reminder's lead for data given as an expression.

.jst_txt_null_remedy

the stop for NULL given as the data.

.jst_txt_both_missing

jrecode() and jencode()'s stop for a code the map also assigns as an ordinary value.

.jst_txt_sav_bytes

what SPSS's limits in bytes mean in letters, in jsave()'s note on shortened labels and its stop for a long factor category (Session 390: the note said "fewer letters when they are accented", which says nothing of Chinese, where 120 bytes is 40 characters).
